services.name: Dolphin Adventure Cruise
services.desc: Welcome to Voyager Deep Sea Fishing and Dolphin Cruises! Join us on a cruise through the Inland Waterways of the Carolinas out to the Atlantic Ocean, where we’ll get to watch the Shrimp Boat Fleet work their nets. This happens to be feeding time! Weather permitting, our crew will also haul aboard a net. Some of the different things that can be pulled up from the net are: shrimp, crabs, fish, sea urchins, seahorses, sand dollars, seashells, sting rays, and baby sharks. This 2½ Hour Sunset Dolphin Sightseeing Cruise is an exciting marine adventure for all! This is the trip where you can also 2.5 Hours • Cruise the Waterways of the Carolinas • All ages welcome!

services.name: 12 Hour Gulf Stream Fishing Trip
services.desc: Welcome to Voyager Deep Sea Fishing and Dolphin Cruises! Cruise with the Captains who offer more fishing time than any other Gulf Stream boat in the area. quotes.author: Laura Dawson
quotes.text: It was thunderstorms earlier and the crew got out towels and wiped everything down-Captain very personable and getting his crew in line to make sure everyone had a good time. We didn’t really care if we saw dolphins or not? We saw one! But it is a very pleasant boat ride with good facilities and clean- good crew and nice boat- unbeatable for the price! Everyone on board was very pleasant. An all around good time. We went later at 6 pm, more for the sunset and boat ride than the dolphins! Very enjoyable.
